sample_unit: gastroenterologist raters (each rated responses to 11 colonoscopy questions)
unlisted_practices: Head-to-head expert rubric comparison of two consumer LLMs on patient colonoscopy questions in Turkish, rated for accuracy, applicability, comprehensiveness, and communication

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the accuracy and communication quality of ChatGPT-4 and Google Bard on patient questions about colonoscopy using expert clinical raters, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
